soundness_flags.label: lem:district-cell-linearity
soundness_flags.one_line: The statement equates a cell of the supplied full law P_a^s with a one-district response functional although the preceding definitions only say that c is an extracted district-factor cell; introduce a separately typed extracted-factor kernel and its reduction map before asserting this equality.

soundness_flags.label: thm:recursion-soundness
soundness_flags.one_line: DCTFTR is described only by informal verbs (simplifies, unnests, extracts admissible factors), with no transition rules, factor language, or failure trace grammar, so termination and output equality are not yet determinate claims.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:optimal-layer3-acquisition
soundness_flags.one_line: Neither a cost function on realizable menu cells nor the target possibly-optimal set is defined, so a minimum-cost characterization and submodularity question have no specified optimization problem.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1, 2, 5, and 6
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The sharp fiber, active-face, and arm-order statements are restricted to reduced comparisons whose visited variables form one district and whose common-evidence row is strictly positive throughout the compatible face.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The proposed certificates are sharp conditional results under the stated one-district and common-positive-evidence regime; multi-district completeness remains only an OEQ.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: CTFTR is sound and complete for conditional counterfactual transportability from observational and experimental distributions across heterogeneous domains, and its factor transport condition is vertex-selection based.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper introduces realizable Layer-3 counterfactual SCB actions and gives graphical equivalence/partial-order characterizations plus an action-space refinement algorithm.

The published UAI paper studies transportability for structural causal bandits by integrating source-environment invariances into target deployment and reports improved sample efficiency for identifying the optimal action.

Add a complete binary one-district worked instance computing A_D, m_D, Z_D, the dual certificate, and the one-cell breakpoints; use it to exhibit a source Layer-3 datum outside both the CTFTR and single-domain CTFIDU+ input settings.

Define a cell-cost map and a formal possibly-optimal arm set, then state acquisition as a finite optimization problem with a precise submodularity predicate and a certificate format for any obstruction.
State and prove the strict model-class relation to both comparator regimes, including a concrete district-closed shift with source-labelled realizable Layer-3 input that neither comparator accepts.
